question: Which NSCC members list NYSE and Amex equity processing?
answer: The saved NSCC directory lists 76 member records with LST, the listed-equity service, as of 2026-06. Each card keeps its member identifier, services and clearing number where supplied.

sections.title: The records
sections.sub: Click a mark above to open its full card here. Each card links directly to the complete reference record.

groups.label: NSCC directory: processes NYSE/Amex equity through NSCC (LST)
groups.note: Guide to Symbols: “LST — Processes NYSE and/or Amex equity transactions through NSCC.” Closer public proxy for listed-equity processing than the CNS muni-preference flag. Still not Rule 2/2A full-service membership and not proof this firm was the CCP counterparty on a given order. Correspondent/prime sub-accounts can carry LST.
